Terms & Conditions

By booking a service with Arushi RO Service, you agree to the following terms and conditions.

1. Service Calls

Our technicians will visit your premises at the scheduled time. Please ensure someone is available to provide access to the RO system.

2. Charges & Payments

A standard visiting/inspection fee may apply. Replacement parts will be charged separately. We will provide a transparent quotation before starting any repair work. Payments can be made via Cash, UPI, or Online transfer.

3. Parts & Warranty

We use 100% genuine spare parts. A limited warranty of 30 days is provided on our repair work, and standard manufacturer warranty applies to replaced parts.

4. Cancellations

You may reschedule or cancel your booking by calling us at +91 9873881738 at least 2 hours prior to the scheduled time.
